::: {.page-intro}
# Human–Environment Interaction
<p class="lede">How do environmental conditions become human exposure, perception, behavior and health, and how can this knowledge inform spatial design?</p>
:::

::: {.prose .research-thread-page}
<p class="meta">02 · 人与环境交互</p>

## From conditions to lived experience

Human experience unfolds through real exposure and activity. This thread examines how microclimatic conditions shape individual exposure, thermal perception, behavioral choices and health outcomes, and how this evidence can support human-centered spatial interventions.

## Conceptual scope

<p class="research-progression">Exposure → Perception → Behavior → Health → Spatial response</p>
